entries.key: Gears of War::Dom Santiago::Salve de Gnasher de Dom
entries.sourceReference: Gears of War 2 (2008). Genuine roster performer with sixteen newly generated poses; adaptation, not verified source frames. All sixteen native whole-body poses inspected: own costume, body and physical weapon; right-facing, complete feet, no extra performer. Wide cells retain weapon reach under one body scale. Local native muzzle flashes are an adapted firing burst, while the RPG owns one impact. Leon's native correction retains an empty physical tube after firing; invisible RGB under zero alpha is cleaned only during packing.
